result.quote: but if we sit here, we will also die. So come now, let us go over to the camp of the Arameans. If they let us live, we will live; if they kill us, we will die.
result.reason: The key is supported, although the passage says they will die if they stay, not merely that they might. It is not unique because the men also go to the Arameans in hopes of being allowed to live. The wording is understandable but lacks needed specificity and articles; “Why do the men with leprosy go to the Arameans?” would be natural.
